title: Durable admission projections
description: The public shape of one admitted unit of agent work, shared by the SDK, the MCP control plane, the web broker, and the desktop. This is a narrowing of the durable ledger, never a re-serialization of it: execution input, credential fingerprints, and internal identities are absent by construction. Enforced against the Rust type and the TypeScript declaration by grokptah-agent-bridge::orchestration::projection.

RunState.description: `starting` is the interval between an attempt taking this run's lease and its worker acknowledging. It is a real state, not a transient: a crash inside it leaves a lease held and work that may have begun.

AttemptProjectionState.description: Public form of an attempt lease's state. `expired` is distinct from `held` because it is the state a reconciler acts on.

ProviderSendProjectionState.description: What is durably known about whether the work reached the provider. `known_not_sent` and `uncertain` must never be merged: only the first is safe to attempt again.

projectionVersion.description: Contract version, bumped whenever a field is added, removed, or changes meaning.

specKey.description: Immutable execution specification key. Safe to publish: it is a digest, and it distinguishes identical work from merely similar work.

queuePosition.description: One-based position in the bounded admission queue, while queued.

attempt.description: Monotonic attempt number. Never reused, never decreases.

promptPreview.description: Bounded, redacted preview. Never the execution input.

heartbeatAgeSeconds.description: Seconds since the holding attempt last heartbeat its lease. Distinguishes a working turn from a holder that stopped reporting.

leaseExpiresInSeconds.description: Seconds until the attempt lease expires; negative once it has.

routeRevision.description: Fingerprint of the concrete provider, model, endpoint, and credential this work is bound to. A fingerprint, so a route change is visible without any endpoint or credential being published.

teardownUncertain.description: A previous teardown could not be established. The run's lease and capacity are fenced and no new attempt is authorized.

teardownDetail.description: Bounded, redacted explanation of the uncertainty.

retryEligible.description: Whether a new attempt is currently permitted. False whenever the outcome of previous work is unknown — the case where retrying risks doing it twice.

capacityFenced.description: Whether this run currently occupies an admission slot.

remainingDurationMs.description: Remaining wall-clock budget from the sealed bounds.

maxRounds.description: Round budget from the sealed bounds.
